subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located inside the Deku Tree in the same room where the Compass is found.

evidence.quote: This one is located inside the Deku...Tree at the beginning of the game, in the...same room where you get the Compass.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside the Deku Tree, a Gold Skulltula is found on the vine at the bottom after dropping down through the web.

evidence.quote: Inside the Deku Tree after dropping down...through the web you will find another...Gold Skulltula on the vine at the bottom.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls on the water gate in the Deku Tree after dropping down through the spider web.

evidence.quote: After dropping down through the spider...web in the Deku Tree, note the Gold...Skulltula crawling on the water gate.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula can be found in Kokiri Forest during the nighttime after finishing the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: After finishing the Deku Tree go to the...map and wait for night, you 'll find in...the Kokiri Forest during the nighttime.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree in the Hyrule Castle area after the Market makes a Gold Skulltula drop.

evidence.quote: When you arrive in the Hyrule Castle...area after the Market, roll into the...tree and the Gold Skulltula will drop.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the lone tree in Lon Lon Ranch knocks a Gold Skulltula out of the tree.

evidence.quote: Enter Lon Lon Ranch and find the lone...tree here in this area, roll into it and...knock the Gold Skulltula out of the tree.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found along the south side of the inner horse fence in Lon Lon Ranch at night.

evidence.quote: Enter Lon Lon Ranch, it has to be at...night.  Along the south side of the inner...horse fence you will find this thing.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is found at night in Kakariko Village by climbing the stairs on the right and heading right at the top.

evidence.quote: Enter Kakariko Village at night and...climb the stairs on the right then go...right at the top to find this token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is in the brick area of Kakariko Village during the night straight up the stairs.

evidence.quote: Enter Kakariko Village during the night...and head straight and up the stairs....In the brick area there is this token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Kakariko Village during the night, a Gold Skulltula is on the ladder of the tall tower and can be hit using the Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Inside Kakariko Village during the night...you will find this one on the ladder...of that really tall tower, use Slingshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is inside a crate in the small room with pots at the entrance of Hyrule Castle Town.

evidence.quote: Just at the entrance of Hyrule Castle...Town, break the crate in that small room...with all the pots to find this enemy.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located past a fake wall blasted using small Dodongos inside Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Inside the Dodongo's Cavern there is a...fake wall to blast using the small...Dodongos, you'll find this past the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall at the top in Dodongo's Cavern after triggering the Bomb chain reaction.

evidence.quote: In the Dodongos Cavern, after blowing...the Bomb chain reaction, you will find...a Gold Skulltula on the wall at the top.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is hidden behind a statue past a blowable wall inside Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Inside the Dodongo's Cavern there is a...wall that can be blown up leading to...this token hidden behind a statue.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden inside a crate in Goron City after blasting rocks on the top level and navigating the maze.

evidence.quote: Found in Goron City, blast the rocks...on the top level and go through maze,...you will find this enemy in a crate.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is behind a blowable wall section at the bottom of the Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote: At the bottom of the Death Mountain...Trail there is a section of wall which...you can blow up to find this token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Breaking the crate right near the entrance of Death Mountain Crater reveals a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: Break the crate open in the Death...Mountain Crater right near the entrance...to find this particular token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls on the back of a northern house in Kakariko Village during the night.

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Town during the night you...will find this one crawling around...on the back of a northern house.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree on the left just after entering Zora's River drops a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: After just entering Zora's River,...roll into the tree on the left and this...falls out of the tree in front of you.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at night on the ladder near the large waterfall near the end of Zora's River.

evidence.quote: In Zora's River near the end, where the...large waterfall is, there is a ladder...and this enemy is on it at night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula appears only at night on the pillar of a small southeast island in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: In Lake Hylia there is a small island to...the southeast where a Gold Skulltula...appears on the pillar only at night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing bugs into the small hole at the bottom of Gerudo Valley causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote: In Gerudo Valley, drop down to the very...bottom and release some bugs into the...little hole there, this pops out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree on the land southeast of the giant fish monster in Zora's Fountain knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In Zora's Fountain on the bit of land...southeast of the giant fish monster,...roll into the tree to knock this down.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly, a Gold Skulltula is on the wall after finding the princess, requiring the water level to be raised.

evidence.quote: This one is found inside Jabu-Jabu's...belly, after finding the princess it's...on the wall.  Raise water level to get.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping down the hole in Jabu-Jabu's Belly after obtaining the Boomerang leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: After you have acquired the Boomerang,...in Jabu-Jabu's belly, if you drop down...the hole, this one and the next one.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A second Gold Skulltula is found down the hole in Jabu-Jabu's Belly after acquiring the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: After you have acquired the Boomerang,...in Jabu-Jabu's belly, if you drop down...the hole, this one and the last one.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls on the wall in the final room of Jabu-Jabu's Belly before the boss.

evidence.quote: In the final room in Jabu-Jabu's belly...before the boss there is a Gold...Skulltula crawling around on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the small hole in the ground found by taking a left and heading south from Kokiri Forest reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Enter The Lost Woods from Kokiri Village...and make a left then go south.  Drop some...bugs into the small hole in the ground.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Lost Woods, following the path right, left, right, left, left leads to a hole where dropping bugs reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In The Lost Woods go right, left, right,...left, left and here you will find a hole...in the ground.  Drop bugs in it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A hole in the ground beside the orange-roofed shop in Kokiri Forest yields a Gold Skulltula when bugs are dropped inside.

evidence.quote: In Kokiri Forest beside the shop with...the orange roof you will find a hole...in the ground for you to drop bugs in.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Blasting the northwest door on Deku Tree B1 with the Bomb Bag and Boomerang reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Return to the Deku Tree B1 when you have...the Bomb Bag and the Boomerang, blast...the northwest door and find this one.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the middle of a circle of rocks outside Gerudo Valley and burning the web with Din's Fire reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Bomb the middle of a circle of rocks just...outside of the Gerudo Valley and then...burn the web with Din's Fire to find.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing a tree directly beside the castle's east wall on Hyrule Field reveals a hole with a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Directly beside the castle's east wall on...Hyrule Field is a tree for you to bomb...that reveals a hole to drop down.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dumping bugs into the bean hole in the Kakariko Village graveyard makes a Gold Skulltula appear.

evidence.quote: Head for the graveyard in Kakariko...Village and dump some bugs in the bean...hole to make the Skulltula appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls on the southeast side of the Kakariko Graveyard and requires the Boomerang to retrieve.

evidence.quote: This one is crawling around on the...southeast side of the Kakariko...Graveyard.  Need Boomerang to get it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into a hole in the ground at the entrance of Dodongo's Cavern yields a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: At the entrance of the Dodongo Cavern...you will find a hole in the ground to...drop some bugs into and get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the second floor southwest area of Dodongo's Cavern using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head into Dodongo's Cavern when you...have the Boomerang and on the second...floor southwest area you'll find this.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at Lon Lon Ranch at night on the second floor window using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head to Lon Lon Ranch at night with...the Boomerang equipped and look up...at the second floor window to see this.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is located high up on the wall in the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch at night.

evidence.quote: During the night at Lon Lon Ranch head...for the southwest corner and take a look...up on the wall to find this token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls above the waterfall in Gerudo Valley at night and can be obtained with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: When you have the Boomerang, enter...Gerudo Valley at night and this one...is crawling around above the waterfall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula on the back of the house in Lake Hylia at night can be reached using the Boomerang from the bridge.

evidence.quote: Head to lake Hylia at night and take...a look on the back of the house, you...must use the Boomerang from the bridge.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the beanstalk hole on one side of the house in Lake Hylia makes a Gold Skulltula pop out.

evidence.quote: On one side of the house in Lake Hylia...is one of those beanstalk holes, drop...some bugs into it and this pops out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found crawling on the wall at Zora's Fountain at night using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head back to Zora's Fountain when you...have the Boomerang at night and you...will find this guy crawling on the wall.
